proyectos.resumen: From design to reality: custom engineering, fabrication and installation of a dock for an oil well on Lake Maracaibo.
proyectos.meta_title: M/G 01-05 LAGO V — G&T Global Service, C.A.
proyectos.meta_description: Case study: engineering, fabrication and installation of the M/G 01-05 LAGO V dock for an oil well on Lake Maracaibo, delivered by G&T Global Service.

proceso.texto: Infrastructure worn down by time on an active oil well on the Lake.
Design and fabrication of parts tailored to the specific needs of the well.
Dock installed directly on the Lake, using our own equipment.
Structure completed, operational and handed over to the client.

proyectos.cita: Logistics, fabrication and maintenance: one team, every solution.
